pairs.premise:
**Set `X-Real-IP` to its own view of the peer**, overwriting whatever the
client sent. If the client can supply this header through your proxy, the
lockout is defeated and turning the switch on has made things worse than
leaving it off.
pairs.hypothesis: The runbook requires the proxy to set X-Real-IP to its own view of the peer, overwriting whatever the client sent.

pairs.premise:
The app is the network edge in this topology: it trusts no proxy headers, and the
login rate limiter keys on the transport peer. The session cookie is `Secure`
(HTTPS-only) by default. To serve over plain HTTP on the LAN, set
`COOKIE_SECURE=false` — note the cookie then travels in cleartext. Putting a
**TLS-terminating reverse proxy** (nginx/Caddy/Traefik) in front is a different
posture, not the default one: that proxy becomes the edge, so set
`TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS=true` as well, or every client will share the proxy's
rate-limit bucket.
pairs.hypothesis: In the bundled topology the app itself is the network edge: it trusts no proxy headers and the login rate limiter keys on the transport peer.

pairs.premise:
| Store | What survives | Bounded? |
|---|---|---|
| `events` payloads | content previews; full refine summaries in `consolidated` / `undone`; contradiction counterpart triples in `verified` | No — append-only |
| `knowledge_triples.fact` | the lifted sentence | No — a fact outlives any one asserting memory |
| `messages.context` | citation snippets, and cited fact rows untrimmed | Until the conversation is deleted |
| `memory_buffer` | raw content on `done` rows | Yes — `buffer_done_retention_hours`, default 24 |
pairs.hypothesis: Raw content in the memory buffer survives a deletion only for a bounded time.

pairs.premise:
A centralized memory system for AI agents: stores and retrieves natural-language
**memories** (semantic + keyword hybrid search over pgvector), builds an
**entity/relationship knowledge graph** from them, and indexes **code
repositories** into a navigable symbol/call graph. It exposes a REST API, a
WebSocket event stream, and an **MCP** tool endpoint for agents, with a React UI.
pairs.hypothesis: darkmem stores natural-language memories and exposes an MCP tool endpoint for agents.
